When they say the temple is so many years old, it means that from the beginning of the temple, ie the place could still be using the same idol or deity from the original place. When a temple expands later on they will eventually add more deities or make new one, but will generally keep the old still there. The main deity in batu caves is still in the cave, its a spear (vel, yes the same one from the vel-vel issue), but newer ones are added sometimes. So when this temple claims to be 130 years, it does not necessarily mean it was at that site for that many years, but the original deity has been transferred.
